definition_zh: 发生；降临（多指不测之事）；适用于（常用于 woe betide 咒语式表达）
definition_en: to happen to someone, especially something bad; to befall
core_image: 命运之门缓缓打开，不知什么正从门后走来
scene: 夜色渐深，母亲担心着远行的儿子。Woe betide anyone who wakes the sleeping giant.
sceneCN: 这里 betide 是「降临、临头」（第 1 个义项：不幸之事临到某人）；句意是谁吵醒沉睡的巨人，灾祸就降临到谁头上。

derivatives.zh: 同源名词，义为「消息；音讯」，来自古英语 tīd
基础词，义为「潮水；潮流；时节」，betide 由其构成
同族复合词，义为「圣诞时节」

senses.title: To happen to someone, especially ill
senses.definition: to happen to somebody, usually something unfortunate
senses.definitionCN: 降临到某人身上，多指不幸之事
senses.example: Woe betide anyone who wakes the sleeping giant.
senses.exampleCN: 谁吵醒沉睡的巨人，谁就要遭殃。
senses.why: Tide once meant time and event, so things tide themselves upon people.
senses.whyCN: tide 曾指时运、际遇，故事件如潮水般「临到」人身上。

senses.title: To come to pass
senses.definition: to take place or come about
senses.example: No one could say what would betide after the king's death.
senses.exampleCN: 无人能说国王死后会发生什么。
senses.why: An event is what time brings in, like the turning of the tide.
senses.whyCN: 事件即时间所带来的东西，如潮水涨落。

senses.title: To befall as fate
senses.definition: to arrive as part of one's appointed fate
senses.example: The oracle warned of what should betide the hero.
senses.exampleCN: 神谕警示了将降临到英雄身上的命运。
senses.why: Old tide meant appointed time, lending a fatalistic tone.
senses.whyCN: 古义 tide 指注定的时刻，故带宿命色彩。

senses.title: In woe betide, to threaten
senses.definition: in the phrase woe betide, to serve as a threat that misfortune will follow
senses.definitionCN: 用于 woe betide 短语，警告灾祸将随之而来
senses.example: Woe betide the servant who broke a single plate.
senses.exampleCN: 打破一只盘子的仆人可要倒霉了。
senses.why: Sorrow is summoned to tide upon the offender.
senses.whyCN: 悲伤被召唤去「临到」冒犯者身上。

senses.title: To attend or accompany events
senses.definition: to come along with or follow an event or time
senses.definitionCN: 随某事件或时节一并到来
senses.example: Rejoicing betid the harvest that autumn.
senses.exampleCN: 那年秋天随丰收而来的是欢庆。
senses.why: Whatever the season tides in is what betides.
senses.whyCN: 时节带来什么，什么便随之降临。

senses.title: To turn out (archaic)
senses.definition: to prove to be the case in the end; to turn out
senses.definitionCN: 最终证明如此；结局成为（旧用法）
senses.example: It never betid as the schemer planned.
senses.exampleCN: 事情从未如阴谋家所规划的那样收场。
senses.why: How events finally tide equals how they end.
senses.whyCN: 事件最终的「潮向」即其结局。

senses.title: To visit in consequence
senses.definition: to fall upon someone as a consequence of their deeds
senses.definitionCN: 因某人的行为而降临其身
senses.example: Punishment betid the rebels within a week.
senses.exampleCN: 不到一周，惩罚便降临到叛乱者头上。
senses.why: Consequences arrive like water reaching the shore.
senses.whyCN: 后果如潮水抵达岸边般必然到来。

senses.title: To betide well or ill, to fare
senses.definition: in betide well or ill, to go or fare in a certain way
senses.definitionCN: 用于 betide well or ill，指际遇顺利或坎坷
senses.example: However it might betide, the crew held together.
senses.exampleCN: 无论际遇如何，船员们始终团结。
senses.why: One's fortune rises and falls like the tide itself.
senses.whyCN: 人的境遇如潮汐般涨落。

intro.en: Betide is the prefix be- plus tide, in its old sense of time or event.
intro.cn: betide 由前缀 be- 加 tide 构成，此处 tide 用其古义「时运、际遇」。

items.en: the root dā- meant to divide, to allot a time; reconstructed form.
items.cn: 词根 dā- 意为「划分、分派时刻」（重构形式）。

items.en: tīd meant time, season, and by extension what happens.
items.cn: 古英语 tīd 意为「时间、时节」，引申指所发生之事。

items.en: betīdan meant to happen, to befall.
items.cn: 古英语 betīdan 意为「发生、降临」。

items.en: betiden was common in romance and chronicle for what befell.
items.cn: 中古英语 betiden 常见于传奇与编年史中，指遭遇之事。

items.en: now archaic or literary, surviving chiefly in woe betide.
items.cn: 如今已古旧或限于文学，主要存于 woe betide 短语。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the tide root; the near-meaning group gathers words for things happening to people.
note.cn: 形近组共享 tide 词根；近义组汇集「降临、发生」类词。

entries.definition: the rise and fall of the sea; originally, time
entries.definitionCN: 潮水；古义为「时间」——betide 的词基
音讯；消息——同源于古英语 tīd

entries.definition: to happen to, especially something unwelcome

entries.definitionCN: 发生——日常用词，无宿命色彩
发生；披露——侧重事情的显现

normalIntro.en: Betide is be- plus tide: what the times bring upon you.
normalIntro.cn: betide 是 be- 加 tide（古义「时运」）：时运带来的事。

normal.en: The famous phrase is woe betide.
Tide once meant time, not just the sea.
normal.cn: tide 曾指时间，而非仅指海潮。

normal.en: Tidings, news, comes from the same root.
It is now literary and archaic.

abstract.en: See fate open a door and something step through.
abstract.cn: 看命运之门开启，某物正踏步而出。

abstract.en: Feel the water of events rising to your doorstep.
abstract.cn: 感受事件的潮水漫到你的门前。

abstract.en: Hear the storyteller ask what shall betide.
abstract.cn: 听说书人发问：「后事如何？」

examples.en: Woe betide anyone who wakes the sleeping giant.
examples.cn: 谁吵醒沉睡的巨人，谁就要遭殃。

examples.en: No one could say what would betide after the king's death.
examples.cn: 无人能说国王死后会发生什么。

examples.en: Punishment betid the rebels within a week.
examples.cn: 不到一周，惩罚便降临到叛乱者头上。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「必·来」——时运必至，祸福终必来临（betide 谐「必 tide」：潮必至）。

root: 前缀 be-（古英语，表「施加于」）加 tide（古英语 tīd「时间、时节」，词根上溯至原始印欧语 dā-「划分、分派」，重构形式）；古英语 betīdan「发生、降临」，现代英语已属古旧文学用语，存于 woe betide。

sensesIntro.en: From time bringing its events, betide grows misfortune, fate, consequence, and a fixed curse phrase.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「时运带来事件」出发，betide 长出灾祸、命运、后果之义，并凝为固定咒语短语。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the tide of time washing events ashore
core.cn: 核心意象：时间之潮把事件冲上岸

branches.en: How things turn out and fare

intro.en: Betide is a Germanic be- verb on the tide root.
intro.cn: betide 是日耳曼 be- 动词，建于 tide 词根之上。

latinIntro.en: No Latin kin here; the tide family is purely Germanic.
latinIntro.cn: 此词无拉丁同族；tide 词族纯属日耳曼语系。
